config.text: Image 1 is a STYLE reference only: copy its drawing language, never its subject (no fish, no lamb, no card, no paper, no foil, no burgundy). Create a large vertical wall panel, a flat graphic print, one of a homogeneous series of 8. COLOURS: exactly two flat colours in the whole image. The background is one plain flat sky blue, #8EC6EC, edge to edge. The drawing and the lettering are pure white, #FFFFFF. No third colour, no gradient, no texture, no shadow, no outline of another colour, no paper grain, no frame, no border. DRAWING STYLE (as in Image 1): bold cut-paper and linocut silhouettes, sharp and confident, solid white shapes with thick blue cut lines inside them that show the background (fur, feathers, scales, folds of cloth, muscles, fingers), elegant, dynamic and expressive, like a contemporary woodcut. Faces calm and neutral, eyes drawn like real animal eyes, never cartoon, never aggressive. COMPOSITION, identical on all 8 panels: one single figure, full length, centred, its silhouette filling about 60% of the image height, from 22% to 82% of the height, with generous empty sky blue around it. Keep everything at least 8% away from the left and right edges. LETTERING, in white only: at the top, the title in a bold contemporary blackletter (gothic) display typeface, in two lines, a small "LE" above a large "CHEVALIER", centred, with one element of the figure gently crossing in front of one letter. At the bottom, centred, the panel number "I" in the same blackletter style, smaller. Spell the words exactly as given, with their accents. No other text anywhere. THE FIGURE: a centaur knight: the body and four legs of a powerful horse in mid-stride, prancing, joined at the withers to the torso of a knight in a closed helmet with a crest, holding upright a long lance with a swallow-tailed pennant that rises toward the title.
